name.title: Plugin Name
name.description: The name for this BTHome platform instance in Homebridge

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: List of devices to connect to and monitor

name.title: Device Name
name.description: Friendly name for this device (will appear in the Home app)

mac.title: MAC Address
mac.description: Bluetooth MAC address of the device (format: XX:XX:XX:XX:XX:XX)

encryptionKey.title: Encryption Key
encryptionKey.description: 32-character hex key used to encrypt the advertisment data (leave empty if device doesn't use encryption or it's disabled)

lowBatteryThreshold.title: Low Battery Alert Threshold
lowBatteryThreshold.description: Battery percentage below which the device will show as 'Low Battery'

autoDiscoverServices.title: Auto-Discover Services
autoDiscoverServices.description:
Automatically detect the services of this device based on data received.

Note: Event-based services (like buttons) will only appear after their first use, while sensor services (like temperature) appear immediately when data is received.

services.title: Service Configuration
services.description:
Manually specify which services to create for this device when auto-discovery is disabled.
You should add at least one service.

powerOnTimeout.title: Bluetooth Power-On Timeout
powerOnTimeout.description: Maximum time (in milliseconds) to wait for the Bluetooth adapter to power on before giving up
